_readme: THE ONLY FILE YOU NEED TO EDIT. Fill in the values between the quotes.
NOTE: RSVP is switched off (type "none") until a WhatsApp number is added.
shortNames are used where space is tight (top bar, monogram initials, RSVP message). brideParent / groomParent / groomTitle are optional lines around the names.
weddingDate must be ISO: "2026-12-12". weddingTime is free text; the first clock time in it (e.g. 4:00 PM) feeds the countdown, calendar link and search results.
timezone is the offset of the venue, e.g. "+05:30" for India, so the countdown is right for guests anywhere.
googleMapsUrl: paste the Share link from Google Maps (maps.app.goo.gl/...). Leave it "" and directions search for the venue name and address.
rsvp.type is one of: whatsapp | form | url | none. For whatsapp, value is the number with country code and no +, e.g. "919876543210".
timeline: one card per ceremony. 'arabic' is optional calligraphy shown on the card.
backgroundMusic: any audio file in public/music/ ("/music/name.m4a") or a URL. "" hides the music button. Sound only starts after the guest taps Open.
colors: primary is the text tone, secondary the soft background, accent the gold. The 3D gold follows accent.
This _readme key is ignored by the site — leave it or delete it.

bismillahMeaning: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

blessing.arabic: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً
blessing.text: And among His signs is that He created for you mates from among yourselves, that you may dwell in tranquillity with them, and He has put love and mercy between your hearts.

heroSubtitle: cordially invite you to their Nikah
invitationNote: With the blessings of Allah and with hearts full of gratitude.

timeline.title: Nikah
timeline.description: The nikah nama is signed, the qubool hai is said, and dua is made for the years ahead. Lunch follows.

closingDua.arabic: بَارَكَ ٱللَّٰهُ لَكُمَا وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكُمَا وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
closingDua.text: May Allah bless you both, shower His blessings upon you, and unite you in goodness.
